_comment: FAQ entries — edit via /#/admin → FAQs tab. Each entry shows on the pages listed. Use [link text](url) in answers for hyperlinks.

faqs.q: What types of claims do you cover?
faqs.a: Bankruptcy claims, litigation claims, class action claims, trade receivables, judgments, locked digital assets, frozen accounts, government refunds, and seized property.

Capital solutions (assignments, participations, litigation financing, advances, contingency arrangements), trading strategies (OTC brokerage, auctions, private pools, structured portfolios), and advisory (claim analysis, price discovery, complex recovery strategies, expert testimony).
Competitive auction across our network of 500+ institutional buyers. No upfront retainers; we earn a spread on what closes.
Days on simple matters, longer when the docket requires it. Automation enables lightning-fast settlement in the largest cases.

faqs.q: Is this legal or financial advice?
faqs.a: No. Information is general in nature. We introduce you to counsel and tax specialists when a matter calls for it.

faqs.q: Bartz class member — sell or wait?
faqs.a: It depends on your cash needs and tax posture. We quote in days. We'll also tell you if waiting is the better call.

faqs.q: Considering opting out for an independent action?
faqs.a: We model the math against the class settlement and introduce you to specialist counsel if independent litigation makes sense.
We work with publishers on settlement architecture, fairness-hearing positioning, and bulk catalogue dispositions.
Covered. We coordinate counsel across the U.S., UK, EU, and Germany.

faqs.q: How do you price a claim?
faqs.a: Competitive auction across our buyer network. You see a real bid, not an indication.

faqs.q: Which estates are you active in?
faqs.a: FTX, Celsius, BlockFi, Voyager, Genesis. Also smaller and edge-case estates by conversation.
Competitive auction across our buyer network. A real bid in fiat, not an indication.
Our quotes reflect current case law and plan-of-reorganization mechanics. We'll walk you through the math.

faqs.q: Can you handle bulk fund positions?
faqs.a: Yes. Bulk dispositions, side-pockets, time-pressured liquidations. We move size discreetly.
